psychological_meaning: Royal Purple is often associated with royalty, nobility, luxury, and power. It evokes feelings of ambition, wealth, and extravagance. This color also carries connotations of creativity, wisdom, dignity, and independence. It can also symbolize magic, mystery, and spiritual awareness, representing transformation and the higher self.

real_world_examples.title: British Royal Family Crest
real_world_examples.description: Royal purple has historically been used in the crests and emblems of the British Royal Family to symbolize sovereignty and nobility.

real_world_examples.title: Cadbury Chocolate Packaging
real_world_examples.description: The iconic purple packaging of Cadbury chocolate is synonymous with indulgence and quality.
